name: Resource Lifecycle Request Failed
description: Sent to a requester to notify that their resource lifecycle request has been failed.
subject: $data.sourceName: $data.operationType request for $data.machineIdentityName has failed
body:
Resource Lifecycle Request Failed

Hello $data.requesterName,

Your request to $data.operationType.toLowerCase() the $data.machineIdentitySubtype.toLowerCase() $data.machineIdentityName on the $data.sourceName has failed.

Reason for failure
$data.failureReason

Please contact your administrator for assistance.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
